wire_types.seq: non-negative decimal string; compare with BigInt, never Number
wire_types.score: finite number with one decimal; non-solved <=99.9; exact approved answer/alias=100
wire_types.window_epoch: non-negative decimal string; same BigInt handling as generation

auth.ws_auth: HttpOnly role-specific cookie + exact Origin/Host validation; no query token
auth.display_bootstrap: fragment ticket exchanged once, clear fragment before POST; primary display has server-issued display_instance_id/render_generation; previews cannot fulfill
auth.bootstrap_guard: only these two browser POSTs lack preexisting role CSRF; exact Host+Origin, application/json, no cross-origin CORS, body size+rate limits; login returns operator csrf_token; display exchange/current return receipt_csrf_token; all authenticated mutations use role-bound token
auth.display_refresh: valid cookie -> GET display current + snapshot -> WS resume; server rotates render_generation when assigning new primary connection, closes old connection; resume_ready delivers new generation and pending_effects under it; do not resend used fragment ticket or rewrite old batches

stream_rules.relay_stream_seq: separate transport seq for data AND barriers
stream_rules.resume: snapshot as_of_seq -> WS resume(after_seq) -> ordered replay -> resume_ready; detect gap/refetch snapshot
stream_rules.receipts: pending_effects recover unfinished effects; replay does not imply processed; apply/actual render before processed, no old victory animation
stream_rules.round_switch: atomically replace round-scoped visual state, keep independent unfinished effect/receipt queues; pending effects carry origin_round_id/window_epoch; old effects render static history only and do not change current rankings or replay victory
stream_rules.effect_backpressure: RESUMING snapshot/replay restores projections only; their pending_effects/effects are descriptions, never grants and consume no new generation credit. resume_ready at consistent boundary grants <=128 pending effects under new render_generation. LIVE events may include effects only with reserved credit; full credit sends visual feedbacks with effects=[], leaving durable pending. processed, not received, frees credit; then ordered guess.feedback(feedbacks=[] effects=historical grants) continues. Old generations/grants invalidated on reconnect; no snapshot/replay receipts.

api_routes: authenticated stop/maintenance requests, no arbitrary process
official signature -> relay commit -> HTTP ack
atomic STUDIO snapshot+independent as_of_seq; operator only

dto_shapes.round_clock: {time_origin,deadline_at:timestamp|null,remaining_ms:integer>=0|null}; PAUSED uses remaining_ms, RUNNING uses server deadline
dto_shapes.pending_effect: {feedback_id,origin_round_id,window_epoch:decimal-string,delivery_ids:string[],outcome:feedback_statuses enum,status_message,word:string|null,display_name,display_score:number|null,solved:boolean}; generated effects always bind a persisted origin round; independent queue survives round switch
dto_shapes.command: POST body {command,expected_version,args}; header Idempotency-Key; response {command_id,status:pending|applied|failed|cancelled,resource_version,state,error:null|{code,message,retryable}}; GET command query for pending operations
dto_shapes.event_payloads: round.* sends full public round or reveal; ranking.updated sends full ranking; connection.status sends full transport; guess.feedback sends latest_feedback[] and effect mappings; updates are absolute values, never additive points deltas
dto_shapes.actor: {actor_id,display_name,permissions:string[]}; role labels are display-only; permissions checked server side
dto_shapes.published_hint: {stage:1|2|3,text:string,revealed_at:timestamp}; published_hints is array of these objects
dto_shapes.event_kind: kind is literal event for business envelope; heartbeat/resume controls use their own kind
dto_shapes.studio_snapshot: {schema_version,contract_version,session_id,mode,run_purpose,as_of_seq,server_time,public_view,private_round,session_rules,next_rules,readiness,pending_commands}; independent STUDIO cursor; private_round may contain answer; not usable with display cookie
dto_shapes.display_session: {display_instance_id,render_generation,session_id,purpose:primary|preview,receipt_csrf_token,expires_at}; exchange and GET current both return this role-specific shape
dto_shapes.backup_entry: {backup_id:string|null,status:none|running|completed|verified|failed,last_completed_at:timestamp|null,last_verified_at:timestamp|null,app_version:string|null,schema_version:integer|null,model_manifest_id:string|null,location_hint:string|null,last_error:ErrorBrief|null}; relay model_manifest_id=null; location_hint never raw credential/path

request_shapes.session_create: {label:string<=80,mode:official|rehearsal|replay,run_purpose:local|test_live|production,room_binding_id:string|null,rules:SessionRules}; official purpose must be test_live/production and server-authorized; local purpose only with rehearsal/replay; mode/room/purpose immutable; creates CREATED draft after identity/binding validation, does NOT require primary display/full start readiness; primary can then bind to this session; readiness gates enforced on start
request_shapes.session_rules: {duration_seconds:30..600,intermission_seconds:3..30,auto_next:boolean,category_id:string|null,difficulty_min:1..5,difficulty_max:1..5,strict_round_code:boolean}; defaults 240/4/true/null/1/5/true; official strict_round_code=true for first release
request_shapes.round_create: {session_id,expected_session_version,selection:{strategy:random|specific,puzzle_id?:string}}; never client answer/score; selection obeys server rules and published versions
request_shapes.puzzle_draft: {word:Han2..4,category_id,difficulty:1..5,aliases:string[],hints:[{stage:1..3,text:string<=120}],explanation:string<=500,source_ref:string<=500}; approved evaluation/model/calibration required for publish; no frontend pass boolean
request_shapes.puzzle_commands: evaluate:{manifest_id}; approve:{evaluation_id,decision:approve|reject,notes:string<=500}; publish:{approved_version}; disable:{reason}; all have expected_version
request_shapes.scoring_evaluation: {puzzle_version_id,manifest_id,split:explore|calibration|blind,pairs:[{guess,human_rating:hot|warm|cold|exclude}]}; backend computes raw/display/metrics, blind-set scores hidden until annotations locked
request_shapes.replay_commands: {command:start|pause|resume|cancel,expected_version,args:{}}; official source can only be replayed into new replay session, never live ledger
request_shapes.runtime_commands: {command:stop|request_maintenance,expected_version,args:{reason,operation?:backup_local|verify_local_backup|restore_new_instance|upgrade_app|switch_model}}; request only, native user confirmation/UAC/approved paths govern; no arbitrary executable/path/url
request_shapes.ready_official: READY_OFFICIAL means official-mode shell ready with can_test_live OR can_go_live; the two booleans and visible test/production label remain mandatory; never infer release from enum alone
request_shapes.session_start: {command:start,expected_version,args:{run_purpose:test_live|production|local}}; must equal server-bound purpose, verified against platform binding/permissions and corresponding readiness; arbitrary is_test never grants testing/production authority

http_payload_policies: JSON success {data,request_id,contract_version}; JSON failure {error:{code,message,retryable,details},request_id,contract_version}; platform callback follows official response; private analytics?format=csv uses text/csv+attachment with formula escaping, not JSON

restart_policy.counting: initial attempt excluded; at most 4 start attempts; no automatic live-round revival

ws_control_shapes.resume: {kind:resume,schema_version:1,contract_version,session_id,after_seq:decimal-string}; audience determined by authenticated route, not client field
ws_control_shapes.resume_ready: {kind:resume_ready,schema_version:1,contract_version,session_id,upto_seq:decimal-string,server_time,render_generation:decimal-string|null,pending_effects:PendingEffect[]}; after all projection replay (which creates no effect credit), DISPLAY primary receives new generation and at most128 actual grants; STUDIO null/[]; preview never fulfills
ws_control_shapes.heartbeat: {kind:heartbeat,schema_version:1,contract_version,session_id,server_time,latest_seq:decimal-string,transport:PublicTransport}; not a new event or permission to jump cursor
